prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Samarium (Sm) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a chemistry laboratory with a long worktable of glass flasks, a fume hood and shelves of labelled reagent bottles
Time of day: midday — bright even light.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: a Halloween witch party costume — a tall pointed hat, a lace-up bodice short dress and striped stockings; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she lifts a glass test tube of coloured liquid to eye level against the light to read its colour; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — samarium: a hard silvery metal that slowly yellows in air, found in 1879 in samarskite, a velvety black ore from the Ilmen hills of the Urals that had been named for the Russian mining officer who let scientists study it, which makes samarium the first element named, through its mineral, after a person; alloyed with cobalt it makes magnets that keep their pull where others let go in the heat, driving motors in spacecraft and aircraft, and one of its isotopes eases the pain of cancer in bone — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
